name: Christmas Collection
description: Hand-painted Christmas tree ornaments, made one at a time. Every piece has its own small differences, so yours will be truly one of a kind.

name: Floral Collection
description: Ceramic pieces decorated with hand-painted flowers inspired by Petrykivka art. Each piece carries its own small differences, so no two are exactly the same.

name: Brushes
description: Experience the authentic soul of Ukrainian folk art with the traditional Koshashka brush. Hand-bound by master artisans and crafted from ethically gathered, ultra-soft cat fur, this indispensable tool is the secret behind the fluid, mesmerizing strokes of UNESCO-recognized Petrykivka painting.
